name: v275_corp_action_minus_earn_eval_020
hypothesis: Corporate-action sentiment fade is strong but too correlated to the new earnings-evaluation carrier; subtracting a small earnings-evaluation sleeve may preserve corporate-action residual while moving top daily-PnL corr below the strict gate.
field_notes: Local daily-PnL grid on 88zxYRQv suggested minus 0.20*npg5egk8 proxy keeps Sharpe proxy ~1.69 and top ACTIVE corr ~0.57.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, group_rank(ts_rank(ts_mean(-1 * vec_avg(corporate_action_sentiment), 5), 180), industry) - 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_mean(-1 * vec_avg(earnings_evaluation_sentiment), 5), 180), industry), -1)

name: v275_corp_action_minus_earn_eval_025
hypothesis: A slightly stronger earnings-evaluation subtraction may improve the correlation margin if the 0.20 residual remains too close to npg5egk8.
field_notes: Local grid: minus 0.25*npg5egk8 proxy top corr ~0.55, Sharpe proxy ~1.63.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, group_rank(ts_rank(ts_mean(-1 * vec_avg(corporate_action_sentiment), 5), 180), industry) - 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_mean(-1 * vec_avg(earnings_evaluation_sentiment), 5), 180), industry), -1)

name: v275_corp_action_minus_earn_and_release
hypothesis: Corporate-action fade also had moderate correlation to the earnings-release indicator; a tiny release-indicator subtraction may balance both new carriers.
field_notes: Local grid: minus 0.20*npg5egk8 and 0.05*qMAJGLQv proxy top corr ~0.56, Sharpe proxy ~1.63.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, group_rank(ts_rank(ts_mean(-1 * vec_avg(corporate_action_sentiment), 5), 180), industry) - 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_mean(-1 * vec_avg(earnings_evaluation_sentiment), 5), 180), industry) - 0.05 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_mean(-1 * vec_avg(nws18_ber_fast_d1), 5), 180), industry), -1)

name: v275_acb_minus_earn_eval_020
hypothesis: The ACB corporate-action layer matched corporate_action_sentiment metrics but may have tiny implementation differences; the same 0.20 carrier subtraction tests whether either representation passes strict corr.
field_notes: Local grid on 9qwOmdrr was essentially identical to 88zxYRQv, but strict platform corr can differ after resimulation.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, group_rank(ts_rank(ts_mean(-1 * vec_avg(nws18_acb), 5), 180), industry) - 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_mean(-1 * vec_avg(earnings_evaluation_sentiment), 5), 180), industry), -1)

name: v275_acb_minus_earn_eval_025
hypothesis: A stronger ACB carrier subtraction provides a lower-correlation fallback if the 0.20 variant remains above the strict threshold.
field_notes: Local grid: minus 0.25 earnings-evaluation proxy top corr ~0.55 with acceptable Sharpe proxy.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, group_rank(ts_rank(ts_mean(-1 * vec_avg(nws18_acb), 5), 180), industry) - 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_mean(-1 * vec_avg(earnings_evaluation_sentiment), 5), 180), industry), -1)
